audit_1_dataset_integrity.details: All 62 judgments, 50 queries, 57 candidates, and 5 negative controls accounted for with exact ID parity. Provenance flags human_reviewed: false and adjudicator_type: ai_assisted_external_evidence strictly preserved.

audit_2_source_registry_reconciliation.details: 35 unique source records reconciled against 62 judgment references. Discrepancy in Phase A.3 summary table (reported 34 vs 35) explained: DailyMed negative control NC-043 was grouped under FDA Approved Drug Labeling rather than the DailyMed product tier.

audit_3_evidence_support.details: 21-record sample (33.9% coverage, 100% of grade changes and 100% of negative controls) verified against active Tier 1 medical repositories. Content and rationales conform to benchmark relevance rubrics and Rule 4.2.

audit_4_evaluation_harness_compatibility.details: Harness architecture supports separate evaluation track via a non-mutating adapter without writing to gold_judgments.jsonl or confusing AI research labels with official gold labels.

ai_assisted_evidence_verified_retrieval_.labeling_requirement: Must be explicitly labeled "AI-assisted evidence-verified evaluation"

official_human_gold_evaluation.reason: Blocked pending licensed clinician adjudication under Phase A.2 human review protocol.

ragas_langfuse_phase_c.reason: Blocked pending authorization of Phase C.

required_changes: Parameterize judgment loading: add judgments_path: Optional[Path] = None and allowed_statuses: Optional[Set[str]] = None.

Support research evaluation mode: when judgments_path is specified, load from evidence_verified_judgments.jsonl accepting statuses {"evidence_verified", "grade_changed_after_research", "negative_control_verified"}.
Preserve official gold path: when judgments_path is None, default to gold_judgments.jsonl requiring judgment_status == "human_reviewed".
Metadata isolation: write evaluation_track ("ai_assisted_evidence_verified" vs "human_reviewed_gold") to run_metadata.json and summary outputs.
